title: The Drowned Bell — single clapper revision
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: supplied Drowned Bell concept sheet. Revise this creature's silhouette and interior anatomy in ALL its views while keeping the landscape 3:2 sheet, dark flooded mine, black water, scale cue, restrained gritty painting, warm/cold light relationship, main view left, state inset upper right, omen lower right and small shape studies along bottom.
The owner sees an unintended paired-sac resemblance. Redesign the living bell as a BROAD FLARED ASYMMETRIC HOOD with a definite outward-curving bell rim and taut ribbed membrane, slightly crooked shoulders and an angular crown. Inside it hangs EXACTLY ONE CENTRAL CLAPPER-LIKE ORGAN: a narrow FLAT, FACETED, DARK OSSIFIED WEDGE, like a worn blade-shaped bone striker, anchored once at the crown and ending above/near the rim. It is clearly a single unpaired solid angular piece. Remove ALL rounded hanging sacs, paired organs, bulbous lobes, soft oval danglers and sac-like bunching. The hood is broad and flattened rather than bag-like. Keep a sparse organic texture and slight bruising so it remains a living unsettling organism.
MAIN VIEW: full bell-hood over the same black pool; the ONE angular central striker easy to read through the open underside, generous negative space around it. Upper-right contracted/expanded states show the SAME SINGLE STRIKER and hood, no duplicated organ within either state. Lower-right ripples/suspended-droplet omen stays a pool context with no body. Bottom small shapes must reflect the new broad flared hood and one central narrow wedge.
Keep grotesque dark fantasy physicality, worn ivory membrane, dull charcoal/brown striker, wet rock. No eyes, teeth, human anatomy, genital cues, added limbs, chains, literal metal church bell, magic aura, text, arrows, labels or HUD. The revision should read as an unnerving bell organism with one clapper at a glance, including at a small size. This is a concept draft, not a runtime export.
review_status: Owner-requested form revision; revised draft pending review
